usedFor: SprintOps holds tasks and sprints, and MailerLite adds the people involved as subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a task is assigned” in SprintOps, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Assignment names who is involved, so that person lands on a list you can email.

watchOut: “When a task is deleted” is an option, so skip it unless a removed task should still add a subscriber.
